verdicts.rationale: Pagin2021 is an identical duplicate of survivor pagin2021compositionality (same title, author, year, journal, 14(3):551-591, same DOI). Zotero-style key vs hand key; only survivor indexed.
Pagin2023 (unpublished manuscript Dec 2023) matches survivor stub pagin2023coherence — same title, author, year. Same manuscript; only survivor indexed.
Palmer2016 and palmer1999 are the same book (Vision Science, Palmer, 1999, MIT Press) as survivor, same ISBN family. Only survivor indexed.
papineau1993david is an identical duplicate of survivor papineau1993 — same title, author, year, publisher, ISBN 9780631189022. Neither indexed.

papineau2006phenomenal (published incollection 2006) is the published version of survivor preprint papineau2002phenomenal — same title, same DOI 10.1093/0199243824.003.0005. Preprint vs published; only survivor indexed.
Patel2014 is an identical duplicate of survivor patel2014topographic — same title, authors, 18(7):351-363, same DOI. Only survivor indexed.

patel2022steps and PatelGrosz2022 are duplicates of survivor patelgrosz2022steps — same title, authors, 39(4):693-748, same DOI. patel2022steps has a folder but is not indexed; only survivor is indexed.
PatelGrosz2023 matches survivor patelgrosz2023primate — same title, authors, 9(1):63-72, same DOI 10.1515/lingvan-2022-0004. Year 2024 vs 2023 is online-vs-issue date. Only survivor indexed.
Pautz2020 is an identical duplicate of survivor pautz2020puzzle — same title, author, 30(1):257-272, same DOI. Only survivor indexed.

All five losers are the same Peacocke book Sense and Content (1983/1984, OUP), sharing ISBN 9781280809941 or bare-title variants. Legacy shadow keys and reimports; only survivor row exists as indexed target.

Peacocke2009 shares the title 'The Perception of Music: Sources of Significance' but is a DISTINCT publication: journal The Modern Schoolman 86(3):239-260 with a different DOI 10.5840/schoolman2009863/41, whereas the survivor is British Journal of Aesthetics 49(3):257-275, DOI 10.1093/aesthj/ayp016. Different venue, pages, and DOI — do not merge.
Peacocke2024 is an identical duplicate of survivor peacocke2024two — same title, booktitle, 157-179, same DOI, same chapter. Only survivor indexed.
